title: teamLab to Open Biggest Museum Yet in Tokyo
paragraphs: Imagine jumping through space on lights that look like planets. Or drawing an animal on the wall and watching it come to life and run away. Or just sitting on a mirrored floor as giant flowers fly around you, until you can't tell where the room ends and you begin.
teamLab has been giving people experiences like these since 2001 — and its mix of digital art and real life is about to get even bigger.
The Japanese art group has announced that it will open a new museum in Tokyo, and it will be its biggest museum yet.
teamLab is an art collective that brings together art, science and technology. With its works, it hopes to "explore the relationship between the self and the world," according to its website.

The new museum will be teamLab's third museum in the Japanese capital, joining teamLab Planets in Toyosu and teamLab Borderless in Azabudai Hills. For now, it's being called teamLab Tokyo, although that name may change.

teamLab Tokyo is being planned for Tokyo's Ariake district, and will cover an area of more than 33,000 square meters. There are plans for a small forest, a plaza and a cafe outside, while the group hopes to involve the community by offering things like programming lessons to students in the area.
The museum will have different sections, with some sections set to open in January 2032, and others in January 2033.
While this will be teamLab's largest museum, the group also has museums in other parts of the world, including Abu Dhabi and Macau.
A new museum is also being built in Hamburg, Germany, and it will be teamLab's largest exhibition in Europe.
